Commentary.Commentary: UPDATE - 1445 local (0945 GMT) - Well, the rain which had stopped has begun again. The conditions look gloomy as well. Hard to see play happening before 4.30 pm local. Fingers crossed. Stay tuned for further updates. PREVIEW - Two games and one-sided victories for Pakistan! Yes, they were expected to win, yes, it is a depleted Bangladesh side but the visitors just don't look like they have the urge of winning in them at the moment. Their bowlers were poor in the last game and their batting seemed even worse. Except for Tamim Iqbal no batter seems to be willing to apply themselves. The series is done and dusted but the visitors would be eager to end on a high note. Probably a chance in batting order would be good, maybe Soumya Sarkar up the order may just work well for them. However, with it being the last T20I of the series, we might just see them tinker with their XI, give a chance to players like Mahmud, Mithun and Shanto. Whatever it is, they will have to be at their best against a Pakistan side who will be eager to inflict a whitewash. They look a formidable bowling unit with the likes of Rauf, Afridi and Hasnain. It is the bowling department that have set up both the victories for them and they would be relying on them once again. Their batting did not fare that well in the first game but the good thing is, some or the other batter is stepping up when needed. They are favorites to win it 3-0. Can they do so or will there be a surprise?
